By thc end of the lesson, pupils should be able to: i..identify shapes of objects in/outsidc the classroom; ii. draw different basic shapes and label correctly; iii. identify the shapes with similar real objects around them. E.g. Orange, Desk, Cup, Tin, Notebook etc.

By the end of the lesson, pupils should be able to: i. distinguish objects of different sizes in/outside the classroom; ii. draw objects of various sizes and shapes (small and big); iii. identify types and size of objects around them. E.g. small chair, big chair, small cup, big cup, big and small rectangle etc.

By the end of the lesson, pupils should be able to: i. explain and trace origin of colour; ii. identify the basic colours (Red, Yellow and Blue) in/outside the classroom; iii. relate the basic colours with objects in/outside the classroom.

By the end of the lesson, pupils should be able to: i. mix basic colours e.g. Red, Blue, Yellow to get secondary colours; ii. identify secondary colours in/outside the classroom; iii. form a colour wheel, showing the basic and secondary colours.

By the end of the lesson, pupils should be able to: i. explain colouring and functional artwork e.g. Cup, Basket, Pot etc; ii. identify some functional artworks in/outside the classroom; iii. draw and cologr functional artworks
